title: Lawyer Loses His Mind When Girls Cut Buffet Line at Wedding
description:
A Florida-based attorney who specializes in bankruptcy and commercial litigation found himself on the other side of the law after an incident at a wedding in January. Mark Roher allegedly got angry when two girls cut the buffet line in front of him at the prime rib carving station. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
